note: ACR-INF estimates the constant-quality price of a MID-class seller at 250ms (acr_estimator/hedonic.py REF_MODEL_CLASS, REF_LATENCY_MS). A median over a whole catalogue is not that: it runs down to $1.7e-08/token on open-weights models, which the hedonic stage would adjust away rather than average in. So the basket is a named mid-tier selection, and the fetch supplies prices for these rows only.

source.price_field: pricing.prompt and pricing.completion, USD per token, as strings

rule.blend_note: A 75/25 prompt:completion blend approximates a read-heavy agent workload. Stated because the aggregate is a function of this choice: the same catalogue gives a ~1000x gap prompt-only and ~588x blended.
